description: Fetch every match played at a specific FRC event, including qualification, playoff, and finals. Returns full match records with alliance compositions, final scores, game-specific score breakdown (auto/teleop/endgame components), winning alliance, video links, and timing (scheduled/predicted/actual/post-result). Lighter variants: get_event_matches_simple, get_event_matches_keys.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_matches
